topic: Total babysitting earnings for an evening based on an hourly rate
core_question: A babysitter earns $12 per hour and works for 6 hours one evening. Find the total earnings. (secondary: Two friends share a $58 bill. One agrees to pay $12 more than the other because they ordered a bigger meal. How much does the person paying less owe?)
answer_summary: the total of $72 (6 hours of babysitting at $12 per hour); after the topic shift: the smaller share of $23 (the other friend pays $35, $12 more)
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there
